description: Defines the class State_SPM representing the state variables of a battery cell for a state-space model, including state indices, member functions for accessing and modifying states, and methods for overwriting geometric and characterization states.

classes.name: State_SPM
classes.description: A class representing the state variables of a battery cell for the state-space model, including indices for various physical quantities and methods for state access and modification.

methods.name: zp
methods.description: Returns a span over the transformed lithium concentration at the positive inner nodes of the positive particle.

methods.name: zn
methods.description: Returns a span over the transformed lithium concentration at the positive inner nodes of the negative particle.

methods.name: z
methods.description: Returns a span over both z_p and z_n.

methods.name: T
methods.description: Accesses the cell temperature state variable.

methods.name: delta
methods.description: Accesses the thickness of the SEI layer.

methods.name: LLI
methods.description: Accesses the lost lithium inventory.

methods.name: thickp
methods.description: Accesses the thickness of the cathode.

methods.name: thickn
methods.description: Accesses the thickness of the anode.

methods.name: ep
methods.description: Accesses the volume fraction of active material in the cathode.

methods.name: en
methods.description: Accesses the volume fraction of active material in the anode.

methods.name: ap
methods.description: Accesses the effective surface area of the porous cathode.

methods.name: an
methods.description: Accesses the effective surface area of the porous anode.

methods.name: CS
methods.description: Accesses the surface area of cracks at the surface of the negative particle.

methods.name: Dp
methods.description: Accesses the diffusion constant of the cathode at reference temperature.

methods.name: Dn
methods.description: Accesses the diffusion constant of the anode at reference temperature.

methods.name: rDCp
methods.description: Accesses the specific resistance of the combined electrodes for the cathode.

methods.name: rDCn
methods.description: Accesses the specific resistance of the combined electrodes for the anode.

methods.name: rDCcc
methods.description: Accesses the specific resistance of the separator.

methods.name: delta_pl
methods.description: Accesses the thickness of the plated lithium layer.

methods.name: SOC
methods.description: Accesses the state of charge or related variable.

methods.name: I
methods.description: Accesses the current state variable.

methods.name: viewGeometricStates
methods.description: Returns a span over geometric state variables.

methods.name: overwriteGeometricStates
methods.description: Overwrites geometric state variables with provided values.

methods.name: overwriteCharacterisationStates
methods.description: Overwrites characterization-related state variables with provided values.
